name: Salt Wound
text:
Frequency once per day

Trigger A creature that has blood and is not at its maximum Hit Points hits you with a melee Strike

---

Effect You channel salt and brine from your blood into the creature's wounds. The creature must attempt a Fortitude save using your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher. On a failure, the creature takes 1d6 persistent,acid damage and is Sickened 1 by the pain. On a critical failure, it instead takes 2d6 persistent,acid damage and is Sickened 2.
